lines.text: Greetings. Are you a tournament contestant?
Great! I'll setup the tournament area for you.
Here are the rules. Clean up the stains in the specific area of the Xiranite Dam. We'll clock you based on the time you spent cleaning up the stains.
The amount of time spent will be recorded on the leaderboards. The fastest cleaners will get better rankings.
Unlike the previous competition, we've added a few bounce devices. This lets our contestants perform some mid-air stain cleaning.
Feel free to start any time you're ready.
